Memory by release

Working size per task

scan: highest point while reading and planning write: highest point while Proceed writes undo: held after the writes, Undo on offer

Each panel has its own scale, starting at zero, so a flat line means the task held the same. The figure beside a panel's name is its peak's change from its first comparable release to the last. A line starts where its measurement became comparable; a faint vertical line marks where one starts later than the others.

What a closed dialog leaves

MB still held after the dialog closes. Anything that grows run after run is a leak; a steady few tenths is a fixed cost, and a jump of about a megabyte either way is usually a heap compaction. The release gate flags a change over 2 MB at once, and runs a growth over 1 MB several times on one page to tell the two apart.

−1 MB+2 MB· bold: over 1 MB
